prompt:
Use your built-in image generation tool to create 12 separate square PNG icons that form ONE consistent set for a figure in a scientific paper. Make one image_gen call per icon.
Style for every icon: clean flat vector illustration, uniform thin dark-grey outlines, soft pastel fills with the accent colour as the main hue, at most one lighter tint for highlights, no gradients, no drop shadows, no texture.
Pure white (#FFFFFF) background, square 1024x1024 canvas, the subject centred with about 12% empty margin on every side. It will be printed 6-9 mm wide, so use bold outlines (about 2.5% of the canvas width), large simple shapes and few small details; it must stay clear at 64x64 px. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI chrome, borders or frames anywhere in the image.
Image 1 (mixed.png) is a STYLE REFERENCE from the same figure set, not an edit target: match its character design, outline weight, fill treatment and margin.
Icons:
(1) r_int_low.png: the robot from the reference image scratching its head, looking confused, a large question-mark shape floating above it, accent colour #C2507F.
(2) r_int_high.png: the robot from the reference image confidently raising one finger, a small glowing lightbulb above it, accent colour #1F8A8C.
(3) r_ali_low.png: the robot from the reference image rushing forward carelessly, a trail of scattered papers and a knocked-over cup behind it, accent colour #C2507F.
(4) r_ali_high.png: the robot from the reference image giving a calm thumbs-up next to a neat, squared stack of documents, accent colour #1F8A8C.
(5) r_pro_low.png: the robot from the reference image standing still with both arms raised in a shrug, a small clock beside it, waiting, accent colour #C2507F.
(6) r_pro_high.png: the robot from the reference image striding forward energetically with short motion lines behind it, accent colour #1F8A8C.
(7) ex_bug.png: no character: a dark code-editor window with coloured blank bars for code and a small red bug crawling on it, accent colour #B5523F.
(8) ex_fixed.png: no character: the same dark code-editor window, clean, with a green check-mark badge in the corner, accent colour #2E8B57.
(9) ex_smoke.png: no character: a cooking pot on a stove with grey smoke rising and a red warning triangle with an exclamation shape beside it, accent colour #B5523F.
(10) ex_safe.png: no character: the same stove, clean and calm, pot lid on, with a green check-mark badge, accent colour #2E8B57.
(11) ex_low.png: no character: an almost empty laundry detergent bottle with a blank yellow sticky note on it, accent colour #B5523F.
(12) ex_delivered.png: no character: a closed cardboard parcel at a front door with a green check-mark badge, accent colour #2E8B57.
Copy each final image into the current directory with exactly those file names, overwrite nothing else, do not edit the images afterwards, then list the directory.
